subject: Requesting information pertaining to Lavaan's functionality for a manuscript

messages.author: 8ba47839f1162862
messages.subject: Requesting information pertaining to Lavaan's functionality for a manuscript
parts:
Dear Lavaan community,

I am completing a manuscript regarding an application of growth curves in an ecological/life science paradigm. However I suspect the paper may be controversial for reviewer #3.

In order to be prepared in my defense I was hoping to learn more about the relationships between latent variables. Specifically, are there differences in any parameter values a model will generate if it has the latent variables for only a single (same-construct) variable, versus a model that had the growth curves and their latent variables modeled for more than one same-construct variable? I suppose what I'm asking if the covariance structure between either the raw or latent variables impacts the calculations for their means, variances, standard errors, etc. If so are the formulas available publicly?

I appreciate everyone in the community for their guidance, as I think this is my second or third post here.

Best wishes,
Brandon Klinedinst
(Graduate Student at Iowa State University)
